agentUtterance.text: Are you an existing customer or a new customer?

requestBody.query: I want to buy an esim

200.answer: As an existing customer, you can buy an eSIM by logging into MyBell and selecting eSIM when adding a new line. You can also switch from a physical SIM card to an eSIM on your current device or transfer your service to a new device with an eSIM through MyBell or Apple's eSIM Quick Transfer.

snippets.text: For new customers: activate online, in the MyBell app, or visit a Bell store. For existing customers: log in to MyBell and select eSIM when you add a new line. If you just want to transfer your Bell Mobility service from a physical SIM card in your device to an eSIM, log in to MyBell or contact us.
